description: Source code for logging central functionality in an EFI-based firmware, including buffer management, logging scheduling, and output handling.

methods.name: scheduleLogging
methods.description: Appends thread-local logging buffer to the global accumulation buffer, with buffer size checks.

methods.name: swapOutputBuffers
methods.description: Swaps the output and accumulation buffers, returning the current output buffer for printing.

methods.name: printPending
methods.description: Sends all pending log data to the communication layer.

methods.name: scheduleMsg
methods.description: Formats and schedules a log message, handling locking and buffer management.
